recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a male musician seated against a heavily distressed, textured plaster wall, flanked by an acoustic guitar, featuring weathered, large-scale vintage typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered as the primary vertical axis
Guitar acts as a secondary vertical weight to the right
Textured background provides a gritty, organic frame for the clean subject
Typography spans the upper third to balance the visual weight of the seated figure
coreInvariants: Distressed plaster texture with peeling paint effects
Soft, directional lighting creating subtle shadows on the wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-full shot of a seated man, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark body of the acoustic guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the guitar neck to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the subject's head and shoulders to emphasize the wall texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green and warm grey (background wall)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and charcoal (clothing and guitar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between the dark subject and the mid-tone background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep umber instead

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif with vintage proportions
letterConstructionRules: Spurred serifs on mid-points of letters like 'R' and 'S'
Distressed, stamped texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' features a dropped, curved tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A weathered, decorative slab serif paired with a clean, wide-set geometric sans-serif for modern-vintage contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and impact for the display text.
Matches the geometric, wide-set nature of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a brown denim jacket and dark jeans sitting on a wooden chair against a distressed, peeling sage-green plaster wall. An acoustic guitar leans against the wall to his right. Soft natural lighting from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, condensed slab-serif title in off-white with a weathered texture at the top. Below it, add a subtitle in a wide-spaced, dark sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the wall texture visible through the main title?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar is proportional to the subject
Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the weathered texture on the font looks organic
Confirm the lighting on the subject matches the shadows on the wall
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated portrait + Distressed wall + Acoustic instrument + Weathered slab-serif header = Americana Aesthetic
